title: Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel Pop-Up Store "Tokimeki Time Slip" Opens in Shibuya and Namba
excerpt: A limited-time pop-up store themed around Showa idols, featuring newly drawn illustrations of Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel, will run at HMV&BOOKS SHIBUYA from December 29, 2026, to January 11, 2027, and at HMV&BOOKS NAMBA from March 19 to 31, 2027.
content:
A limited-time pop-up store for Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel, an anime that is still loved today, long after its TV broadcast, will be held under the title "Tokimeki Time Slip" (ときめきタイムスリップ). It will run in two cities: at HMV&BOOKS SHIBUYA in Tokyo from December 29, 2026, and at HMV&BOOKS NAMBA in Osaka from March 19, 2027.

The theme this time is "Showa idols." Creamy Mami appears in costumes and makeup reminiscent of the idols of that era, in entirely newly drawn illustrations.

In addition to new goods that use the newly drawn illustrations, the venues will have photo spots and a display of toys that recall those days. It is a chance to take a heart-fluttering time slip back to those nostalgic days and meet a special Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel.

Creamy Mami in costumes inspired by Showa idols (Gold and Red outfits)

  • Dates: Tuesday, December 29, 2026, to Monday, January 11, 2027 (holiday)

  • Hours: 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM
  • Access: Shibuya Modi access information

Year-end and New Year business hours:

Hours during the year-end and New Year period may change. Please check the store's official website for details.

For details on business days and hours, please check each facility's website or official X account.
